title: withProperties cursor stability
description: Expected Foundry-compatible response shape when loadObjects is invoked on a withProperties ObjectSet with a single count metric. Pagination must be stable: result rows are ordered by (firstDerivedValue ASC, primaryKey ASC) so offset-based paging never drops or duplicates base objects.

pagination.comment: Tied derivedValue rows fall back to primaryKey ascending; empty link sets (count=0) sort first.

responseShape.nextPageToken: <base64 cursor or omitted on final page>

notes: A dedicated parity runner is not yet wired up; this fixture documents the expected shape for US-005 and will be consumed by test/foundry_parity/run.go once the Phase 6 Gate introduces it.
Numeric tie-break uses primary key string comparison; the executor copies the inner result's PrimaryKeys slice before sorting so nested callers continue to see the inner order.
